# Gareth Matthews

> Founder & CEO of DEPARTMNT. 15+ years across culture and commerce: clubs, artist management and
> global brand programmes, now building the infrastructure for a more connected world.

Gareth Matthews is the founder and CEO of DEPARTMNT (https://departmnt.xyz), a London company
building TapTech: the Tags people tap, the Portal a tap opens, and Core, where brands run it. No
app, ever. He started DEPARTMNT in 2021; it incorporated in May 2025, and Kadeem Henry later joined
as co-founder. Before DEPARTMNT he DJed from 13, held a residency at Ministry of Sound, managed
the grime artist Novelist (his first world tour, partnerships with Uniqlo, New Era and Casio
G-Shock), and led programmes for Mercedes-Benz, The National Lottery and AB InBev's BEES.

## Site structure

- [Home](https://www.garethmatthews.uk/): Profile, clients, selected DEPARTMNT work, client
  films, earlier work.
- [Work](https://www.garethmatthews.uk/work/): Every project. DEPARTMNT projects link to their
  full case studies on departmnt.xyz; earlier work (artist management, live events, brand
  programmes) has case studies on this site with a Brief, What We Built and Outcome.
- [About](https://www.garethmatthews.uk/about/): Background, founder memo, principles, speaking
  topics and FAQ.
- [Press](https://www.garethmatthews.uk/press/): Boilerplate, short and medium bios, headshot and
  facts for media use.
- [Thoughts](https://iammrgm.substack.com/): Writing, on Substack.
- [Contact](https://www.garethmatthews.uk/contact/): Enquiry form, email (hello@departmnt.xyz)
  and a 30-minute call link.
